definitions.gloss: surely not, no way, by no means
definitions.explanation: Expresses disbelief or denial that something could be true or happen.

definitions.gloss: just in case, in the unlikely event
definitions.explanation: Used with の/に to mean 'in case of emergency' or 'for an unexpected situation.'

examples.japanese: まさか{彼|かれ}が{犯人|はんにん}だとは{思|おも}わなかった。
examples.english: I never thought he could be the culprit.
examples.notes: Expresses surprise at an unexpected truth

examples.japanese: 「{合格|ごうかく}したよ」「まさか！」
examples.notes: Used as an interjection expressing disbelief

examples.japanese: まさかの{時|とき}のために{貯金|ちょきん}している。
examples.english: I'm saving money for a rainy day (in case of emergency).
examples.notes: まさかの時 = emergency, unexpected situation

notes:
USAGE PATTERNS:
・まさか〜ないだろう (surely...won't)
・まさか〜とは{思|おも}わなかった (never thought that...)
・まさか！ (No way! - as an exclamation)
・まさかの{時|とき} (in case of emergency)
・まさかの{事態|じたい} (unexpected situation)

NUANCE:
まさか conveys strong doubt or disbelief. When something actually happens that you thought was impossible, you might say まさか本当だとは... (I never thought it was actually true...).
